name: Home Calendar — The Warm Ledger
description: Two-voice palette: dusty rose structures, warm cream breathes. Rose carries text; teal ink for long-form reading text. Status colors appear only as dots, badges, and destructive actions.

rose.usage: nav backgrounds, active fills, borders, header bands

rose-deep.usage: focused input borders, hover-darken on rose surfaces

cream.usage: page background, cards, inputs, text on rose

cream-shade.usage: hover-darken of cream buttons on rose headers

ink.usage: long-form reading text on cream; never on rose (use cream)

danger.usage: delete buttons and trash icons ONLY; rarity is its meaning

urgent.usage: overdue chores, high priority, error text

ok.usage: on track, low priority, success feedback

muted.usage: distant deadlines, quiet indicator dots (rose-tinted neutral)

rose-a12.usage: badge and progress-track backgrounds, grid hairlines

cream-a35.usage: quiet borders and placeholders on rose

cream-a60.usage: secondary text and resting input borders on rose

rules: The Inversion Rule: the only hover/active pattern is a full rose<->cream swap. No gradients, no opacity tricks on interaction.
The Two-Voice Rule: page surfaces speak rose and cream only; rose carries text on cream, teal ink long-form reading; status colors are accents, never surfaces.
Delete red (#C71414) appears on destructive controls only. Overdue/error text uses urgent (#DB324D).

chartFallbacks.note: chart.js canvas cannot resolve CSS variables; use concrete hex with 0x99 alpha suffix for fills
